dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

Hand colored. Relief shown by hachures. Depths shown in fathoms. Shows parish boundaries, mileage from St. John's anchorages, hazards to navigation, and cultural features. Includes listing of acreage by parish and inset of "English Harbor." Scale ca. 1:54,000.
